'''Major Pathel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] until he joined a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was head of security at [[the Wall]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. In secret, he helped initiate new members into the Revanites by interviewing them during their [[Pilgrimage (Order of Revan)|Pilgrimage]], the name given to the final task Revanite initiates undertook before being accepted into or rejected from the cult.
